name: Sarah Rahman
bio: We've been inseparable since freshman year. She's now a doctor in Chicago but we still try to meet up whenever she visits home.

name: Michael Chen
bio: My former team lead at Google. He taught me everything I know about system design and still gives me career advice.

name: Priya Sharma
bio: We grew up in the same neighborhood and our families are still close. She's an architect and we always joke about designing our future homes next to each other.

name: David Okafor
bio: My gym partner who pushes me to be better every single day. We've been training together for 2 years and he's helped me achieve my fitness goals.

name: Emily Watson
bio: We met at a local bookstore 5 years ago and bonded over our love for Murakami. She's a high school English teacher and we share book recommendations monthly.

name: Ahmed Hassan
bio: My neighbor who taught me how to make authentic Egyptian dishes. We have a tradition of cooking together every other Sunday and sharing meals with the neighborhood.

name: Lisa Kim
bio: We did our Masters together and collaborated on multiple research papers. She's now a PhD candidate and we still discuss our research projects regularly.

name: James Rodriguez
bio: Lead guitarist in my band for the past 4 years. We've performed at over 50 shows together and he's been my creative partner since we started making music.
